name: Tax Record 2
definition: Set of elements used to define the tax record.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: High level code to identify the type of tax details.

Category.name: Category
Category.definition: Specifies the tax code as published by the tax authority.

CategoryDetails.name: Category Details
CategoryDetails.definition: Provides further details of the category tax code.

DebtorStatus.name: Debtor Status
DebtorStatus.definition: Code provided by local authority to identify the status of the party that has drawn up the settlement document.

CertificateIdentification.name: Certificate Identification
CertificateIdentification.definition: Identification number of the tax report as assigned by the taxing authority.

FormsCode.name: Forms Code
FormsCode.definition: Identifies, in a coded form, on which template the tax report is to be provided.

Period.name: Period
Period.definition: Set of elements used to provide details on the period of time related to the tax payment.

TaxAmount.name: Tax Amount
TaxAmount.definition: Set of elements used to provide information on the amount of the tax record.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Further details of the tax record.
